FAQ

Common questions about China to ADD air freight.

Can oversized cargo fly from China to ADD Addis Ababa?

It depends on package dimensions, gross weight, lifting points, aircraft availability and destination handling at ADD. For large pieces, we first check loading feasibility before discussing the airfreight rate.

When should LGG/BRU Europe transit be considered for ADD?

LGG/BRU should be considered when China direct flights cannot accept the cargo size, weight or timing. Europe transit can create a workable second-leg option for Africa project cargo, but it must be checked case by case.

What documents are needed before quoting China to ADD air freight?

Send commodity, HS Code, invoice value, packing list, dimensions, gross weight, packing photos, lifting points, origin city, destination city and latest arrival requirement. Regulated goods may need extra permits.

Is ADD suitable for mining or engineering project cargo?

Best for industrial, healthcare, manufacturing and infrastructure cargo requiring airfreight speed and clear document planning. The key is not only airport-to-airport freight, but whether customs, handling and inland delivery can support the project schedule.
